body.name: Infimum-approaching bias-aware modulus intervals
body.construction: \(\operatorname{cv}_{\alpha}(t)=\inf\{c:\Pr(|\mathcal N(t,1)|\le c)\ge1-\alpha\}\), and for each \(j\in\mathbb N\), \(C_{\alpha,j}(Z)=[\widehat\theta_{r_{\mathrm{CI},j}}\pm s_{r_{\mathrm{CI},j}}\operatorname{cv}_{\alpha}(b_{r_{\mathrm{CI},j}}/s_{r_{\mathrm{CI},j}})]\).
